readout_other: Self-reported cooling, warming, vibrotactile and mild nociception sensations; thermocouple in tissue phantom
direction_notes: Pulsed FUS to the fingertip elicited cooling, warming, vibrotactile and mild nociceptive sensations; continuous insonification at matched Ispta elicited none.
safety_notes: No adverse skin conditions at follow-up 1 week and 2 months; phantom showed no temperature change; MI and TIS kept below 1 and 0.05.

exposures.label: 350 kHz pulsed FUS to fingertip, 20 and 40 C ambient

target.label: palm side on the tip of the fifth phalange

timing.protocol_description: Tone-burst duration 0.1 ms at PRF 100 Hz or 1.0 ms at PRF 10 Hz, both 1% duty cycle, 10 s insonification per parameter combination, repeated at ambient temperatures of 20 and 40 C. Continuous insonification at 100 mW/cm2 Ispta was also tested as a comparison.

Pressures are per-intensity table values that differ by frequency; domain taken as free field because intensity was calibrated at the focus with a hydrophone in degassed water and no attenuation was applied; paper does not label the table column explicitly
Pulse duration and PRF are paired (0.1 ms with 100 Hz, 1.0 ms with 10 Hz), recorded as parallel lists
Continuous insonification at matched Ispta served as a comparison condition but is real output at a different waveform; recorded as no sham
Target is skin receptors of the fingertip; no matching target id, so other
